_comment: Tracle-Lite egg for Pterodactyl. Import it in Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: Tracle-Lite
author: support@brenaldmedia.com
description: Tracle-Lite WhatsApp bot. The console asks for your WhatsApp number (you get a pairing code) or your session ID. The bot downloads and updates itself.
startup: if [ ! -f index.js ]; then git clone --depth 1 {{GIT_REPO}} /tmp/tl && cp -a /tmp/tl/. /home/container/ && rm -rf /tmp/tl; fi; if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ] && [ -d .git ]; then git pull --ff-only; fi; node index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update
apt install -y git ca-certificates tar
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -f index.js ]; then git clone --depth 1 ${GIT_REPO} . ; fi
echo 'Install done'

variables.name: Session ID
variables.description: Optional. Your Tracle-Lite session ID (TRACLE~... or Tracle_...). Leave empty to type your number or session ID in the console.

variables.name: Phone number
variables.description: Optional. Your WhatsApp number with country code, digits only (example 2345678901234). A pairing code is printed in the console.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: 1 = pull the latest launcher on every start (the bot itself always updates on restart).
